eyebrow: The engine behind every aging calculation
code:
SELECT invoice_num,
       TRUNC(SYSDATE) - invoice_date AS days_old
FROM ap_invoices_all
WHERE invoice_amount > 10000;
caption: date minus date = a plain number of days in Oracle.
ADD_MONTHS handles month-end edge cases correctly; MONTHS_BETWEEN returns a fractional month count.
Always supply the format mask — never rely on the server's default date format.
